title: release review: health + review + orient — integration correctness
description:
Correctness review of the output layer that assembles signals from all lower layers into reports. Bugs here produce wrong reports — the architect makes decisions based on wrong data.

## Approach

Read all files below and review for integration correctness. Produce findings in standard YAML schema. Focus on whether signals from lower layers are correctly consumed, combined, and surfaced.

## Files (~5.4k LOC)

src/health/findings.rs, src/health/scoring.rs, src/health/git_metrics.rs, src/health/drift.rs, src/health/ondemand.rs, src/health/instability.rs, src/health/mod.rs, src/tools/review.rs, src/tools/orient.rs, src/tools/file_health.rs, src/git.rs, src/mcp.rs

## Mandate

- Health findings: Are biomarker calculations correct? Is nested_complexity counting the right AST nodes? Is co_change_scatter using the right statistical measure?
- Scoring: Are the risk score weights reasonable? Does normalization produce sensible 0–1 values, or could extreme inputs produce out-of-range or NaN results?
- Git metrics (git.rs, git_metrics.rs): Are git_churn, git_merge_base, git_diff_files correctly parsing git output? Are there other parsing assumptions like the blame timestamp bug we just fixed?
- Health delta: Does compute_health_delta correctly compare before/after snapshots? Could it report improvements as regressions or vice versa?
- Review compositor (review.rs): Does build_findings correctly assemble all signals? Are any sections silently dropped on error? Does the compute function produce a coherent JSON structure?
- Orient (orient.rs): Does it serve the right conventions for a given scope? Could a component in sketch mode still receive blocking convention violations?
- MCP dispatch (mcp.rs): Are tool arguments correctly validated and forwarded? Could malformed input reach lower layers?
- Component instability (instability.rs): Is Martin's Ce/(Ca+Ce) correctly computed? Are afferent/efferent edges correctly partitioned?
execution_record: Reviewed 12 files (~5.4k LOC) across 5 parallel review agents. Produced 18 findings (1 high, 7 medium, 10 low). Verified top findings against source code. Created 5 follow-up tasks for actionable fixes: sutra/106 (cycle total undercount), sutra/107 (orient alias name), sutra/108 (drift nondeterministic file_id), sutra/109 (file_health component filter leak), sutra/110 (degraded review risk score). Full report at docs/reviews/2026-06-05-health-integration-review.md.
